value.rationale: Natural complete all-sparsity convolution-rank diagram for the smallest nonabelian group, not an arbitrary slice. Sharp four-tap geometry switch (3+1 excludes rank two; 2+2 admits every rank 2…6) makes support distribution, not just sparsity, a structurally relevant parameter. Constructive exact witnesses on every fixed support aid finite noncommutative Fourier sampling and erasure designs; no larger theorem is implied.
